issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URLs without percent-encoding, so '/', '?', '#', or '..' can change the request path/query.
Transport failures and timeouts are not retried or wrapped, leaking raw httpx exceptions from the SDK.
Retry-After parsing ignores HTTP-date values, which are valid per the header contract.
Backoff parameters are not validated; negative values can reach sleep(), and jitter can exceed the documented cap.
Pagination trusts response shape without validation, so malformed JSON can raise unrelated exceptions or loop incorrectly.
Batch results are sorted by server-supplied indexes without validating missing, duplicate, or out-of-range results.
Model parsing performs inconsistent type and enum validation, allowing invalid API data to become client objects or raw KeyErrors.
Frozen dataclasses contain mutable dict fields, so model immutability is only shallow and payloads/labels can be mutated after construction.
Dev tooling only includes pytest; no formatter, linter, type checker, or coverage gate is configured for ongoing maintenance.
